overall: The AG found no violation: library staff and volunteers were incidental to a Purpose 1 executive session about three employees, so they did not need individual notice or a right to attend.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the council discussed library staff and volunteers in a Purpose 1 executive session without individual notice or a chance to be present.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, because library staff and volunteers were not the subject of the executive session discussions, they were not entitled to be present during the executive sessions, and the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by not giving them individual notice of the May 1, 2025, meeting.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
